text:
sam: Hi team — first week here. Trying to get dev env stable on an M1 Air. I'm using fish, asdf, and 1Password SSH agent. Node builds are fine but python builds keep failing (ssl/zlib). Also direnv won't load .envrc on fish. Any quick hits?
rachel: Welcome! :wave: For fish, make sure you put env exports in config.fish or use set -x. Example for Homebrew/asdf libs:

set -x PATH /opt/homebrew/bin $PATH
set -x LDFLAGS '-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/libffi/lib'
set -x CPPFLAGS '-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/include -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libffi/include'
set -x PKG_CONFIG_PATH /opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib/pkgconfig

Then restart the shell and re-run `asdf install python 3.11.4`.
devin: also make sure asdf python plugin uses the system build env: `env PYTHON_CONFIGURE_OPTS="--enable-optimizations" asdf install python 3.x`. For zlib you might need `brew install zlib` and then add `-L/opt/homebrew/opt/zlib/lib` to LDFLAGS.
sam: I have zlib & openssl installed. The build log still shows cannot find -lssl. Might be wrong PKG_CONFIG_PATH.
rachel: run `pkg-config --libs openssl` to verify. If it prints nothing, your PKG_CONFIG_PATH is wrong. For fish, `set -x PKG_CONFIG_PATH /opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib/pkgconfig` then `exec fish` to reload.
kai: For direnv on fish, ensure you have the hook in config.fish: `direnv hook fish | source`. Also install the direnv plugin for asdf-managed shells if you use multiple shells.
sam: Direnv was the issue — I didn't enable the hook. Now it loads .envrc. Still stuck on ssh keys though: 1Password shows agent enabled but `ssh-add -l` returns "The agent has no identities."
devin: Two things: 1) 1Password sometimes exposes different sockets depending on whether app or CLI is used. Run `lsof -U | rg 1password` or `socat - UNIX-CONNECT:$SSH_AUTH_SOCK` to validate. 2) If using GPG-backed keys, ensure pinentry is configured and gpg-agent has `enable-ssh-support` in ~/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf, then `gpgconf --kill gpg-agent && gpgconf --launch gpg-agent`.
rachel: Also: if your shell session was started before 1Password CLI login, the socket env var might not be exported. Add to config.fish: `set -x SSH_AUTH_SOCK (gpgconf --list-dirs agent-ssh-socket)` after you confirm that command prints a path.
sam: Running `gpgconf --list-dirs agent-ssh-socket` prints `/Users/sam/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent.ssh`. I set SSH_AUTH_SOCK accordingly and now `ssh-add -l` shows my key.
kai: Nice. One more thing: open a tiny PR to our dotfiles repo (docs/macos-fish.md) with the fish snippets you added. We have a template in the repo.
dotfiles-bot: Please remember to add a changelog entry when you submit PRs in the dotfiles repo: templates/CHANGELOG.md.
sam: Will do — thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick help!
devin: If anything weird pops up around native vs x86 Homebrew, ping me. We keep a note in onboarding about not mixing prefixes.
rachel: Welcome again :tada: If you want a quick pairing session to check other dev tooling (IDE, secrets, devcontainers), I'm free after standup.
